description: Graphite with 90k CMC: adsorbed CMC sets excess adhesion and the coated mechanical contact plane; free CMC smoothly suppresses both RE2 attraction and short-range adhesion. The shipped free_g_L=0 is the adsorbed-only first test.

cmc._concentration_units: Both concentrations are g CMC per litre of aqueous phase. Adsorbed and free inputs are independent; excess adsorbed input is capped, never transferred to free CMC.
cmc._saturation_reference: Gwag et al., ACS Nano, DOI 10.1021/acsnano.6c10201: apparent adsorption 0.37 +/- 0.09 wt% per particle mass (Gr+CB). Approximate reference conversion for this graphite-water model (neglecting the small CMC share of the paper's total solids): 0.0037 * 997 g/L * 0.44 / 0.56 = 2.8984214285714285 g/L aqueous phase. This is a converted model benchmark, not a directly reported 2.9 g/L measurement. Reassess this explicit reference if solids loading or material changes.
cmc._adhesion_model: theta=min(adsorbed_g_L/adsorbed_saturation_g_L,1); q=(1-(1-sqrt(q_sat))*theta)^2; W_eff=W_bg+q*(W_bare-W_bg). interaction.adhesion_work_J_m2 remains the bare graphite reference.
cmc._q_sat_reference: 0.33 is the agreed starting benchmark for saturated excess-adhesion retention, not a measured CMC constant.
cmc._free_cmc_units: free_g_L is already g CMC per litre of aqueous phase: 1 g/L = 1 kg/m3. It is not total CMC; do not subtract adsorbed CMC again or apply a solids-volume factor. Free CMC is never capped or increased by the adsorbed-input clamp.
cmc._contact_model: Hc=h0+contact_offset_at_saturation_m*theta. The offset is the effective combined distance of both coatings. 2 nm is a starting modeling assumption, not a measured saturated CMC-layer thickness. RE2 uses the actual carbon gap H; adhesion opening and mechanical contact use H-Hc. Sliding friction coefficient and stiffness remain unchanged.
cmc._free_cohesion_model: u=min(free_g_L/nonadhesive_concentration_g_L,1); qf=1-10*u^3+15*u^4-6*u^5. Phi=qf*(Phi_RE2_attractive+Phi_adhesion)+Phi_RE2_repulsive, with existing geometry and outer cutoff. Free input is uncapped; only screening saturates. This replaces the exponential free_repulsion law.
cmc._free_cohesion_reference: Effective cohesion-suppression closure, not a measured electrostatic force law. 13.2 g/L is the initial 16 g/L endpoint hypothesis. Validate high-free nonadhesive viscosity before fitting intermediate concentrations; it is not a universal polymer constant.
